definitions.name: F2D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of its largest element, the first one when several tie

definitions.name: F2D.MAXKEY
definitions.body: 'MR' BIND MR KEYS MR VALUES F2D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the key holding the largest value, the earliest key when several tie

definitions.name: F2D.UNWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of words -> one String with the words joined by single spaces (inverse of G0A.WORDS)

definitions.name: F2D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case

definitions.name: F2D.VMAX
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element of a non-empty Vector of numbers (or Strings)

definitions.name: F2D.VMIN
definitions.body: 'NV' BIND NV NV 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty Vector of numbers (or Strings)

definitions.name: F2D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'SV' BIND SV SV LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SV SV LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle ones when the count is even)

definitions.name: F2D.LEDGER
definitions.body: 'LG' BIND LG [ 0 GET ] MAP LG [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> Record name to sum of its amounts, names in first-appearance order

definitions.name: F2D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE 'DS' BIND DS 0 DN DS G0A.MOD 1 LT SELECT [ 0 GT ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> Vector of its positive divisors, ascending

definitions.name: F2D.ISPRIME
definitions.note: positive integer -> TRUE when it is prime

definitions.name: F2D.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'CE' BIND [ 'CV' 'CT' ] BIND 1 CV 2 DIV CV 3 MUL 1 ADD CV 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT CV 1 EQ SELECT CT CT 1 ADD CV 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step for Collatz: [ value steps ] dummy -> [ next-value steps+1 ], unchanged once the value is 1

definitions.name: F2D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'CN' BIND 1 150 RANGE CN 0 2 COLLECT [ F2D.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: positive integer (up to 150 steps, enough below 100) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: F2D.BINARY
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND BN [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] DIV FLOOR 2 G0A.MOD STR JOIN 'BS' BIND BS CHARS BS '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
definitions.note: integer 1..63 -> its base-2 digits as a String without leading zeros

definitions.name: F2D.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER [ 'ORD' BIND ORD 'qty' GET ORD 'price' GET MUL ] MAP G0A.SUM
definitions.note: orders JSON text -> total of qty times price over the orders that have a price

definitions.name: F2D.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders JSON text -> Record sku to total qty, skus in first-appearance order

solutions.ledger.debtors: F2D.LEDGER 'DR' BIND DR KEYS [ 'DK' BIND DR DK GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE [ 1 GET ] MAP F2D.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ F2D.CAP ] MAP F2D.UNWORDS
solutions.orders.unpriced: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: G0C.ORDERS [ 'tags' GET ] MAP [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'SX' BIND SX SX F2D.MEDIAN SUB F2D.ABS F2D.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'MX' BIND MX -2 DROP MX 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MX 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RX' BIND RX RX 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.stats.range: 'RV' BIND RV F2D.VMAX RV F2D.VMIN SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'NX' BIND NX NX F2D.VMIN SUB NX F2D.VMAX NX F2D.VMIN SUB DIV
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
